messages.financeVat: {place}: documents are issued without VAT ({reference}) — set the rate to 0.
messages.financeFloat: {place}: pass numbers as strings (floats are not accepted).
messages.financeNoLines: A document needs at least one line.
messages.financeConversionLinked: The {source} is already linked to another {target} — open it instead; a new one is not created.
messages.financeConversionSourceMissing: The source {source} was removed — reload the page.
messages.financeRestoreItemDenied: A line is restored only together with its document: add the removed line to the document's table again.
messages.financeNumberReadOnly: The number of a saved document or payment does not change: a new one gets it from the counter, an imported one keeps the Vtiger number.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeyTouch: Insert your security key and touch it.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeyWaiting: Waiting for a touch of the key…
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeyCancelled: The key was not confirmed: the time ran out or the action was cancelled.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeyRejected: The key was not accepted. Try again or use another registered key.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeyTooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and sign in again.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeyInsecure: The browser cannot reach a security key here: a secure address (HTTPS) and a browser with security key support (WebAuthn) are required.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeyError: Could not reach the security key.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeyNone: No security key is registered for your account. Ask the administrator to turn two-factor authentication off, sign in with your password and register your keys again.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeySetupIntro: Insert a key, press "Add key" and touch it. Add a backup key as well: if all keys are lost, only the administrator can restore your sign-in.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeyResetNote: Your previous keys were removed. Add all keys you are going to use.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeyAlreadyAdded: This key has already been added.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeyMax: No more than {max} keys can be added.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeySetupFailed: The keys were not saved: the check failed or the setup time ran out. Add the keys again.
messages.itvolgaSecurityKeySetupUnknown: Could not check whether the keys were saved. Close the window and open Security again: if 2FA is on, the keys were saved.
